info.title: Shellui Storage API
info.description: Object storage API for Shellui. Authenticate with a Bearer JWT issued by identity-service. Use **Authorize** and enter `Bearer <token>` or paste the raw JWT.

get.description:
Returns delivery status, attempt counts, and errors for the company.

Permissions: Shellui company owner for the JWT `company_id`, or Shellui staff. Send `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` from identity-service. MCP agent tokens act as the company owner. Service API keys (`esk_`) cannot call these routes.

Side effects: Read-only.

Sends email: No.

Destructive: No.

Staff may filter by `scheduled_job_run_id` (not exposed on MCP).

parameters.name: scheduled_job_run_id
parameters.description: Staff only (403 otherwise): deliveries with an attempt made by this scheduled job run (`GET /api/v1/scheduled-jobs/runs/<id>`).
